moments.title: UK Braces for Fifth Summer Heatwave
moments.blurb: Temperatures across England and Wales are expected to soar into the mid-30s this week, with a chance of hitting 36C, as the UK experiences its fifth heatwave of summer 2026.

angles.name: Heatwave warning
angles.copy: Another heatwave is baking the UK this week, with parts of England and Wales potentially hitting 36C. Stay cool out there!

angles.name: Summer sizzler
angles.copy: It's a summer sizzler! The Met Office is forecasting highs in the mid-30s. Perfect excuse to blast some tunes and chill.

moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off Next Week
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season is set to begin on Saturday, August 22nd, a week later than usual due to the expanded World Cup.

angles.name: Football is back
angles.copy: Get ready, football fans! The Premier League returns next Saturday, August 22nd. Who are you backing for the title this season?

angles.name: Season opener countdown
angles.copy: The countdown is ON for the Premier League kick-off! After a summer of transfers, it's time for the real action to begin.

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff

angles.name: Cardiff hosts Shield
angles.copy: Cardiff's Principality Stadium hosts the Community Shield this Sunday! Arsenal vs Man City – who's taking home the first silverware?

angles.name: Big game in Wales
angles.copy: A huge game coming to Cardiff this weekend! The Community Shield brings top-flight football to Wales. Are you going?

moments.title: Metro Bank One Day Cup Matches

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Returns This Autumn

angles.name: Strictly's back

angles.name: New Strictly hosts

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' continues its incredible run, holding the Official UK Singles Chart #1 spot for a potential 21st week (chart dated Aug 6-12).

angles.name: Longest running #1
angles.copy: 21 weeks and counting? Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are making chart history! What's your favourite #1 hit right now?

moments.title: Madonna & Kylie Eyeing Top 10 with 'Love Sensation'

angles.name: Espresso comeback

angles.name: Chart re-entry
